answers.how: The fully visible plane is approximately 237 pixels long and moves approximately 350 pixels/s. Its length is 237 × 22.16 / 350 ≈ 15.0 m.
The plane's vertical extent is approximately 73 pixels. Using the motion-derived scale, its height is 73 × 22.16 / 350 ≈ 4.62 m.
The plane moves in a straight line at the given speed, so its displacement over 0.5 seconds is 22.16 × 0.5 = 11.08 m.
